metadata.name: Classic
metadata.description: Markdown theme for Azure DevOps Wiki output, with configurable page framing and optional child-topic links.
metadata.author: Kambiz Khojasteh

pageHeader.description: Markdown inserted before the generated content on every page. Accepts one string or an array of strings joined with newlines, and may contain Handlebars expressions that use the page's template data.

pageFooter.description: Markdown inserted after a horizontal rule at the end of every page. Accepts one string or an array of strings joined with newlines, and may contain Handlebars expressions that use the page's template data.

seeAlsoSubtopics.description: When true, appends a See Also list of a topic's immediate child topics to each topic page.
